title: Get started
subtitle: Set up your deployment step by step — every step is verified against the live control plane.
allDoneHint: Every step is verified against the control plane. You can revisit this wizard at any time.

dismissed.title: Setup guide dismissed
dismissed.description: The guide is hidden on this browser. Your deployment keeps working — you can resume the verified steps at any time.

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.hint: The database must be reachable before anything else.
infra.ready: The control plane can reach its database. This step is verified automatically.
infra.notReady: The control plane cannot reach its database yet.

workspace.title: Create your first workspace
workspace.hint: A workspace scopes agents, sources and policies.
workspace.name: Workspace name

identity.title: Invite an administrator
identity.hint: Invite a second administrator, or connect your identity provider.
identity.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. The new administrator can change it later.

source.title: Register your first source
source.hint: Connect a content or governance source. Credentials are stored by reference.
source.name: Source name
source.noFields: This connector needs no further configuration.
source.secretHint: Enter a value to seal, or a store:<name> reference.
source.testFail: The connector could not open — check the configuration.
source.notRunning: A source is registered but not yet running — check its status above.
source.credByRef: Secret fields are sealed into the store and referenced as store:<name> — a credential value is never stored inline.

pep.title: Activate your first policy enforcement point
pep.hint: Publish a managed-settings policy and confirm a host applied it.
pep.notPublished: No managed-settings policy is published yet.
pep.active: A host has attested this policy — the enforcement point is active.
pep.awaitingHint: The policy is published and signed, but no host has checked in yet. Deploy the snippet and refresh.
pep.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
pep.noCheckins: No host has checked in yet.
